svg.title: Open GW from Spotlight or the Dock (recreation)
svg.desc: Recreated cropped Spotlight panel. The search Green & White returns a synthetic Green & White application result with the GW icon. Safari apps can be opened from the Dock, Applications, or Spotlight.
